narrow.shape.wrapped: Register either one once, and it covers every decimal: nullable ones, dictionary keys, and every value object over a decimal, since its JSON is the underlying type's.
narrow.input.json: Both read a number, or a string holding one, and keep the scale they read.

excludeReasons.reason: A closed set wraps nothing, so it holds no decimal for a decimal converter to write (docs/json.md#decimals-in-one-spelling covers decimals, nullable ones, dictionary keys and value objects over a decimal).
A value at the root is not held by a containing type, so shape.containing has nothing to apply to.
System.Text.Json serializes a field only under IncludeFields (or [JsonInclude]), so without it the member is in no document and no converter runs in either direction, for the plain type alike.

System.Text.Json refuses JsonObjectCreationHandling.Populate together with a reference handler (InvalidOperationException when the options are used; harness/JsonRow.cs runs such a row without Populate), so no row can set both.
